findings.comment: Electric Service Planning Application (ESPA) approval not documented in the plan set. New electrical service is being provided to 39 residential units; ESPA submission and approval from Austin Energy Design Services is required but not evidenced in the submitted documents.

Austin Energy Utility (AEU) clearance letter not located in the submittal package. While Austin Energy's completeness check is noted as complete in the master comment report, a formal AEU clearance letter confirming no conflicts is not evidenced in the submitted materials.
Plans do not include a note stating that the site lies within the Austin Energy service area. A note confirming Austin Energy service area coverage is required on the general notes sheet.

Plans do not include a note stating that the developer is responsible for designing and constructing all conduit and related infrastructure to current Austin Energy Electric Service Standards, including conductor installation costs, and for coordinating with other utilities to resolve all conflicts.

Plans do not include a specific note that a preconstruction meeting with Austin Energy is required prior to starting demolition. Sheet 8 requires a preconstruction meeting with the Environmental Inspector but does not specifically require Austin Energy coordination before demolition work begins.

Additional Review Acknowledgement table is not completed on the cover sheet. This table must list all applicable external reviews, approvals, or permits required for the project (e.g., TxDOT permit, railroad permit, gas company permit, easement acquisition, county approval, water district or MUD approval, Texas Department of Health approval, TCEQ approval, non-occupancy letter, service extension approval, Planning and Development Review Department approvals).

Addressing plan approval status cannot be verified from the submitted documents. An approved addressing plan (separate from any Address Validation Letter) is required for the 39 new residential units. Review of addressing records with 911 Addressing/Address Management Services is needed to confirm plan approval status.
